Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 47
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Monday, Bhadra 8, 2083
1:00 PM
Ministry-wise Question and Answer
The concerned minister will answer oral questions related to the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies.
1. Management Work
On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honourable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present a proposal to "Send the Constitutional Bodies (Remuneration, Service Conditions and Facilities) (First Amendment) Bill, 2083 to the concerned committee for clause-wise discussion."
2. The Honourable Minister for Foreign Affairs, Shishir Khanal, will present a proposal to "Send the Passport (First Amendment) Bill, 2083 to the concerned committee for clause-wise discussion."
3. The Honourable Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, Sita Badi, will present a proposal to "Send the Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Bill, 2083 to the concerned committee for clause-wise discussion."
4. The Honourable Minister for Industry, Commerce and Supplies, Gauri Kumari, will present a proposal to "Send the Mines and Minerals Bill, 2083 to the concerned committee for clause-wise discussion."
Padma Prasad Pandey
General Secretary
